readme: Known, justified exceptions to scripts/governance-scan.mjs. Each entry: rule, path (exact), optional pattern (regex on the line) or lineContains (substring), optional count (max allowed matches; extra ones are findings; ratchet), justification, reviewedBy, optional expires (YYYY-MM-DD; after it the entry stops applying). An entry that matches nothing is reported STALE and fails the scan, so remove an entry when its code is fixed. A whole-file entry (no pattern/lineContains) is allowed only for the scanner's own files. Every reviewedBy is 'PENDING owner review': the repository owner has not yet approved these baselines. A missing reviewedBy is always a finding; `--strict` (for the day the policy-scan job becomes blocking) also reports every PENDING one. A new entry, a higher count or a higher ratchet compared with the base branch copy of this file is a finding unless the scan is run with --allow-baseline-growth (owner approval).

R5.justification: Baseline (ENG-GOV-001): every workspace package's test script uses `vitest run --passWithNoTests`, so a package whose tests are deleted or never discovered still passes. The count must not grow; remove the flag per package once it has tests (or a minimum-tests check exists).
